title: Allow a Small Burst After Idle
description: An API should allow 20 requests immediately after an idle period, then refill permission at one request per second. Which policy expresses that?

options.text: A token bucket with capacity 20 and refill rate 1/s.
options.explanation: Unused tokens accumulate up to 20, allowing a bounded burst. Subsequent requests consume tokens as they refill.

options.text: An unbounded queue drained as fast as workers can run.
options.explanation: That defines neither the intended burst bound nor a fixed admission rate.

options.text: A fixed daily counter with no other limit.
options.explanation: A daily total does not express a 20-request burst or per-second refill.

options.text: A leaky bucket that guarantees no queueing delay at any arrival rate.
options.explanation: A fixed drain rate can smooth output, but bursts require bounded queueing or rejection and can incur latency.
